This expansion removes one of the biggest compliance blockers preventing global enterprises from deploying ChatGPT at scale. Data residency, often an overlooked piece of the enterprise AI puzzle, processes and governs data according to the laws and customs of the countries where it is stored. ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu subscribers can now choose to have their data processed in:
